comment: The Rungic app's root controller system/rungic-plasma (/data/adb/rungic-plasma/rungic-plasma ACTION, run by the app through Magisk su; exit 0 is success, otherwise its output is the message the app shows) and the install state the first-boot script publishes into the app's private files. Here the consumer is the app (MainActivity, FirstBootState, AndroidNetworkBridge) and the provider Rungic's own controller on Android. account-status prints one JSON object: configured (a desktop account exists), pending (an account setup is being applied) or, without a running container, the stored account; the app opens the desktop when configured, waits while pending, else runs account-prepare and shows the account form. memory-status prints the container's memory ceiling as JSON (the device panel's memory setting, through the platform bridge's container-memory). install-state: the release the app expects (RELEASE_ID of files/rungic-install-source.properties, else of the product seed /product/etc/rungic/seed.env) followed by files/rungic-install.properties (schema 2: release, state installing|waiting|ready|failed, phase verify|runtime|rootfs|configure|storage|finish|complete, error a failure code or none), which FirstBootState reads: ready only when the release matches and state is ready; a device without a managed install prints unmanaged=true (the app then opens without a gate). account-prepare, account-setup (the form's payload on stdin), start, restart-session, stop, install-publish, memory-limit, boost and lock change things and are never run by the provider check. Tested from both ends: tools/tests/test_contract_host_controller.py (the app's FirstBootState, compiled here, on the contract's states) and acceptance scenario contract.host-controller (the read-only actions and files on the phone, as root).

queries.name: install-state
queries.comment: The app explicitly accepts existing v1 installs without schema/error, including quoted product-seed RELEASE_ID, as well as v2. Missing source and mismatched releases still block in FirstBootState; this check does not migrate installation records.
queries.command: d=/data/user/0/com.rungic.plasma/files; if [ -f $d/rungic-install-source.properties ]; then cat $d/rungic-install-source.properties; elif [ -f /product/etc/rungic/seed.env ]; then grep '^RELEASE_ID=' /product/etc/rungic/seed.env; else echo unmanaged=true; exit 0; fi; cat $d/rungic-install.properties
